author: bob_mac
body:
I have been playing on the server for nine months, mostly on Nebula and now I like it enough to build a map for it. So far I am not on the staff and no one has told me to build one but I would really want to
have people playing in my map. Once it is done, how will I give the map to the staff to use? I know how to turn maps into folders and upload them onto map websites, but I can't find a way on this server. Please can someone tell me how give the map to staff.
